messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy window requested: urgent hotfix for embeddings-service (regression causing ~5% latency error increase). Target image: rwinference/embeds:1.2.3-hotfix9. Need expedited approvals for canary+fast-rollout in the next 10m. CI: green, preflight checks passed. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/embeds/hf-1.2.3-hotfix9 :deploy:

sre-alyssa: Oncall check: what are rollback criteria? Can we revert to rwinference/embeds:1.2.3? Need clear metrics & runbook.

eng-lead-sam: TL;DR: issue is a batching edge-case with long tail latency on 99p for small payloads. Patch backports only. Rollback target: 1.2.3 (non-hotfix) and old routing weight. Rollback criteria: if error-rate delta >1% or p95 latency increase >200ms for 5m. runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds-hotfix-rollback

release-mgr-kevin: Need 2 engineering + SRE signoffs and a product ack for expedited. Also attach short release note blurb for customer-facing copy.

product-lee: Product ack. Impacting user-facing embedding quality for 0.4% of requests (observed). Approve expedited rollout. Please add this to release-notes drafts: "Fix batching edge-case causing higher latency for short texts. No model changes."

eng-lead-sam: +1 from eng. Codeowner (ml-inference) approves. Approving fast canary + 50% ramp in 15m if canary healthy.

oncall-jordan: Oncall approves. I will monitor telemetry and be ready to cut traffic. Setting pager to high priority for next 60m.

release-mgr-kevin: Approved by release-mgr. Kevin -> tagging deploy. deploy-bot, please start canary and post canary link.

deploy-bot: Canary starting: rwinference/embeds:1.2.3-hotfix9 -> canary hosts: embed-canary-02 (eu1). Health dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1732468005

sre-alyssa: Watching metrics now. p95 latency back to baseline on canary after 3min. error-rate trending down. No obvious memory or CPU spike.

deploy-bot: Canary health: PASS after 6m. Initiating ramp to 50% over 10m. Will post updates every 5m or on status change.

eng-lead-sam: Noted. If anything anomalous, we abort and roll to 1.2.3. Keep rollback command ready: `k rollout undo deploy/embeds --to-revision=1.2.3` and traffic cut: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic/cut?service=embeds&target=1.2.3`

deploy-bot: Ramp update: 50% reached. Monitoring.

sre-alyssa: 10m after ramp—metrics stable. p95 within +20ms, error <0.1%. No rollback.

product-lee: Thx team. Customer comms approved, short blurb updated in release notes page.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout: 100% traffic switched to rwinference/embeds:1.2.3-hotfix9. Deployment finished. Change window: emergency hotfix (no standard downtime). CI artifacts sha: abcdef1234. Release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood/embeds/hf-1.2.3-hotfix9

release-mgr-kevin: Great work. Scheduling a 1hr post-deploy check-in at https://calendar.redwood/kevin/embeds-postmortem in 2h to capture learnings and confirm metrics are stable for 2h. If anything, reopen thread. :party-parrot:

oncall-jordan: I'll keep an eye for 2h. Pager sub is active. If anything triggers, I'll post immediate rollback intent.

eng-lead-sam: Follow-up action: add unit test for small-batch path and add a canary metric to alert earlier. Filing ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-9876

release-mgr-kevin: Closing this thread—hotfix rolled out. Will update release notes and send customer-facing note in 30m.
